articles.title: Zelensky to press Nato for air defence systems after intense Russian strikes
articles.description: The Ukrainian president will use the Nato meeting in Turkey to argue he needs more interceptor missiles.

articles.title: Super Typhoon Bavi strikes US Pacific islands with pummeling winds

articles.title: US accuses China of nuclear proliferation after ballistic missile test
articles.description: The US called China's ballistic missile test in the south Pacific a "great concern" for the world.

articles.title: China carries out ballistic missile test hours after warning neighbouring countries
articles.description: China carried out a long-range ballistic missile test in the south Pacific on Monday, sparking criticism from New Zealand and Australia.
